tldr: Kosovo's former President Hashim Thaci was found guilty of war crimes in The Hague.
A building damaged by a prior Israeli strike in Gaza City collapsed, killing at least 21 people, including eight children.
The US Justice Department has charged Russian agents with plotting attacks, some of which were planned within the United States.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower, influenced by rising oil prices and Treasury yields that are increasing energy and borrowing costs for U.S. households. Market sentiment was also affected by a warning from J.B. Hunt of an expected earnings drop, which led to a significant decline in its stock.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose, driven by increasing borrowing costs for U.S. households, as well as Wall Street's anticipation of a potential Federal Reserve rate hike.

vix.why: The VIX increased, reflecting heightened market volatility and investor uncertainty amid rising energy and borrowing costs and the anticipation of a close Federal Reserve rate decision.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased for the week ending September 10. This rise tracks the upward trend in the 10-year Treasury yield, which has been influenced by rising borrowing costs and market expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike over recent days.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

tech.summary: Apple is reportedly considering re-entering the server hardware market, potentially in collaboration with NVIDIA, to capitalize on the increasing demand for computing power driven by the AI industry.

Google is opening its smart home platform to third-party AI agents, allowing tools like Claude and Open Claw to control connected devices and analyze home data through the new standardized Model Context Protocol.

Anthropic's Claude AI is introducing new 'Docs' and 'Slides' tools, enabling users to create documents and presentations directly within Claude chats, while also unifying its chat interfaces into a single 'one Claude' experience.

world.summary: Hashim Thaci, the former President of Kosovo and a KLA leader, has been found guilty of war crimes in a trial held in The Hague.
At least 21 people, including eight children, were killed in Gaza City when a six-story building, previously damaged by an Israeli strike, collapsed.
The World Health Organization chief warned that the battle against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is far from over, citing a rise in cases in the North Kivu region.
Malaysia has invited Myanmar's military ruler for a visit to the country, aiming to facilitate and accelerate the repatriation process for Rohingya refugees.

us.summary: The US Justice Department has charged Russian agents with plotting attacks, including some within the United States, stating they belong to a network used by Russia to conduct external attacks globally.
The U.S. government has acknowledged for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, following previous warnings about the potential weaponization of this global frontier.
A news helicopter operated by NBC and Telemundo crashed in a Los Angeles neighborhood while covering a nearby bus accident, killing at least three people.

science.summary: Neuroscientists have successfully created mice with human brain cells, providing a new tool to study diseases like cerebral palsy, while also prompting ethical discussions about the treatment of these animals.
New research indicates that even short bursts of vigorous physical movement can contribute positively to longevity, suggesting that the intensity of activity plays a crucial role in health outcomes.
